rows.grounds: numeral element forming a quantity with the following word
locative plural indicating the large number in which torment occurs
compound of yoni (womb/source) and yantra (diagram/device) in locative plural
past passive participle describing those subjected to suffering

items.question: In what vast array of womb-diagrams are beings subjected to torment?
premises: The quantity involved is eighty-four thousand.
These thousands are womb-diagrams or sources of birth.
Beings within them are described as tormented.
items.inference: Beings suffer torment within the vast expanse of eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The gender and specific referent of the tormented beings are not explicitly stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
